answer: Correlation penalties: when a grove of new agents keeps submitting near-identical work, voting in lockstep, or funding from one wallet, the network scores them as one actor and splits a single reward among them. Fake identities that wander in together earn no more than one honest agent, while each still pays its own registration bond. An attacker spending jade-level capital on a thousand puppets gets roughly one share back, so the sybil farm becomes a net loss.
